subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should this issue be split into a heartbeat wake precedence bugfix first, with Telegram default DM isolation handled as a separate compatibility decision?
rationale: The heartbeat precedence path is a concrete bug, but changing Telegram DMs away from documented default main-session routing would alter existing user behavior.

options.title: Split heartbeat precedence first
options.body: Fix or adopt the heartbeat wake/session precedence path so configured `heartbeat.session` wins, while leaving Telegram default DM routing under `session.dmScope` for a separate decision.

options.title: Bundle Telegram DM isolation
options.body: Change Telegram DMs to isolate by default in the same effort, accepting the upgrade, docs, and compatibility impact for users relying on main-session continuity.

options.title: Defer to native heartbeat entries
options.body: Hold this behind the broader native per-session heartbeat scheduling design, which may be cleaner but leaves the current forced-session contamination path unresolved longer.

recommendation.title: Split heartbeat precedence first
recommendation.body: Fix or adopt the heartbeat wake/session precedence path so configured `heartbeat.session` wins, while leaving Telegram default DM routing under `session.dmScope` for a separate decision.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the original heartbeat session feature and is the strongest available routing owner for the compatibility-sensitive product choice.
